deviations: Pages lifted to whole papers: full text = all page transcriptions concatenated (multimodal models can use the page images).
[approx] Aspect group is a heuristic from page position (<=25% motivation, <=60% method, else experiment/result).

format_card.query: Aspect query (motivation / method / experiment-result), many per paper
format_card.document: Whole paper, holistic full text (truncated to model max input)
format_card.answer: One target paper per query; queries grouped by paper
